message:
Hey there, friends! 🌟 I was recently reminded of how much fun we can have when the power goes out. It’s a great chance to unplug and rediscover low-tech activities like board games, candlelit dinners, or even storytelling under the stars. I found a helpful resource that shares tips on what to do during a blackout, and it’s a nice nudge to think about how to keep our families entertained and safe when the lights go out. 

What’s your favorite way to enjoy a power outage? I'd love to hear your tips!
